purpose: Validate linear units, completed-bar timestamps, actual dated-contract coverage and the settlement-source boundary before a financial account is designed. Basis references are not executable returns.
selection: BTC and ETH fixed before new price data. Use the first quarter in the existing 2025 research calendar, not a quarter selected by basis or payoff. This pilot cannot be used to optimize maturity or market selection.
endpoint_limit: Direct read-only response is evidence only for the records it actually returns. Do not infer a missing historical settlement price, past trading status, delivery fee or margin tier from today's metadata or from a filename.
units: UM kline timestamps are milliseconds and volumes are base-asset units/USDT quote turnover; source fixed Binance public-data README. Existing spot source was separately verified with its 2025 microsecond parser. Inverse COIN-M contracts are excluded.
time_rule: A row at opening time t becomes an observation at t+5minutes only if its close-time is exactly t+5minutes-1millisecond and OHLC/volumes are valid. Preserve partial final bars or days; do not manufacture continuity after trading ends.
diagnostics: official zip SHA256 and independent CSV/Decimal values
exact bar grain, duplicates, gaps and observed first/last boundary
same underlying, quote numeraire and historical qualification limitations
settlement endpoint coverage without guessed terminal cash
financial_design_required_after_data_aud: fully specified opportunity/entry/exit clocks and minimally useful net effect
spot and dated futures wallets, margin and free-cash risk
separate fills, base-fee quantity loss and emergency unwind
past-known maturity and explicit early-exit versus settlement policy
both-leg costs, cash/static controls, complete closed/open accounting, restart and capacity gates
